mapper.select: SELECT d.kb_id AS kbId, r.eval_version AS evalVersion, COUNT(*) AS totalQuestions, SUM(CASE WHEN r.hit = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hitCount, AVG(CASE WHEN r.hit = TRUE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS hitRate, AVG(CASE WHEN r.rank > 0 THEN 1.0 / r.rank ELSE 0.0 END) AS mrr, AVG(COALESCE(r.faithfulness, 0)) AS avgFaithfulness, MAX(r.eval_at) AS evalAt FROM kb_eval_result r JOIN kb_eval_dataset d ON r.dataset_id = d.id WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} GROUP BY d.kb_id, r.eval_version ORDER BY MAX(r.eval_at) DESC
